entities.summary: Ben Hutton is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman for the Vegas Golden Knights of the National Hockey League (NHL). A 2023 Stanley Cup champion, Hutton has played over ten seasons in the NHL. During the 2025–26 season, he reached significant career milestones, including ranking in the 96th percentile for Neutral Zone transitions according to NHL EDGE data and maintaining a career-high 8.7% shooting percentage.
